_readme.what: Nether blocks in Overworld structures, swapped when a template loads (patcherMod worldgen/TemplateBlockSwaps). python3 tools/gen_nether_swaps.py expands these rules over every template into exact positions in nether_block_swaps.json; rerun it after editing this file or after mod updates.
_readme.rules: In order; the first rule that matches a block at a position wins. structures: ids (or ["*"] = every Overworld structure); except: ids skipped (plus the plan/move_to_nether tag for every rule); blocks: block ids; to: a block id (stairs, slab, wall and axis properties carry over), "air" (removed), or "deepslate" (the nether brick family to its deepslate brick twin; a fence becomes a wall).
_readme.safety: A template any Nether or End structure can also place is never swapped (Nether builds keep their blocks).
